description.narrative:
Key project rationale: This intervention is essential to strengthening the resilience of refugee and host community women and youth, enabling them to achieve self-reliance through active participation in sustainable livelihood activities. By engaging inincome-generating ventures such as poultry farming for business, environmental conservation, and diversified livelihood options, participants will enhance their economic stability while contributing to the protection and sustainability of their communities.Project Objective: To enhance growth of eco-friendly resilient livelihoods for refugees and host communities through improved food, income security and access to clean energy in Terego district
Anticipated Results after improving the food and incomesecurity as well as the accessibility to clean energy of refugee and host communities?Enhanced Food and Income Security:Refugee and host community households, particularly women and youth, will experience improved livelihoods through the adoption of climate-resilient agricultural practices, poultry value chains, and green business enterprises. Increased productivity, market access, and business formalization will lead to more stable incomes and improved household food availability and nutrition.EmpoweredYouth and Women Entrepreneurs: Through business incubation and enterprise development, women and young people will gain the skills, resources, and support needed to establish and runsustainable green businesses, contributing to household economic resilience and local economic development.Strengthened Climate Resilience: The adoption of climate-smart agriculture and ecosystem restoration approaches will build the capacity of communities to sustainably manage natural resources, adapt to climate change, and reduce environmental degradation.Improved Access to Clean and Safe Energy: With the uptake of energy-efficient cookstoves, households will benefit from reduced fuel consumption, lower exposure to indoor air pollution, and less time and effort spent on firewood collection. This will improve health, safety, and the overall well-being of especially women and girls, while easing pressure on the environment.Increased Community Self-Reliance and Sustainability: Theintegration of livelihood, clean energy, andclimate adaptation interventions will foster self-reliant, environmentally conscious communities capable of sustaining food and income security beyond project support. Expected Beneficiaries: The intervention will directly target 5,950 refugees and host community women and youth, specifically those aged 18- 35 years old considering 50% - 50% representation from both the refugee and host communities. The intervention will also reach other stakeholders in the small livestock and clean energy sectors, who may offer services and products of various kinds.Strategic relevance to Oxfam: the proposed intervention has the primary aim of economic empowerment of refugee youth and women. This directly contributes to Oxfam country strategic objectives (CSF 2021- 2030) ofensuring that marginalized and vulnerable communities are economically empowered and have resilient livelihoods, ultimately contributing to Oxfam's vision of Uganda that is free from inequality and injustice.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education forall, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam established this country office to support local organizations and projects. Through this local office Oxfam Novib directly contributes towards this project’s implementation.
